settings.title: Club Membership
settings.description: A recurring monthly membership that gives clients a credit balance to spend on treatments and products, plus member pricing on selected treatments.

stripeNotice.title: Billed through Stripe
stripeNotice.body: Club plans are charged monthly via Stripe. Connect Stripe under Settings → Online Payments before publishing a plan — plans without a connected Stripe account can't be sold from the client portal.

settings.readOnly: Only admins can create or edit Club plans.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Each plan bills a fixed monthly price and tops up the member's credit every cycle.
plans.emptyHint: Create your first plan to start enrolling members.
plans.deleteHint: Plans already synced to Stripe can only be deactivated.

form.description: Members see the name, description and benefits in the client portal.
form.name: Plan name *
form.monthlyCreditHelp: Credit added to the member's balance every billing cycle. Defaults to the monthly price.
form.benefitsPlaceholder:
One benefit per line, e.g.
Member pricing on all facials
Priority booking
form.benefitsHelp: One line per benefit. Shown as a bullet list in the portal.
form.activeHelp: Inactive plans are hidden from the client portal. Existing members keep their membership.

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently removes the plan. Existing memberships keep their own snapshot of the plan name and price.

toasts.priceInvalid: Enter a monthly price greater than zero.
toasts.creditInvalid: Monthly credit must be zero or more.

panel.title: Club membership
panel.noMembership: This client is not a Club member.
panel.noMembershipHint: Clients join the Club from the client portal. A credit balance can still be adjusted manually.

adjustDialog.title: Adjust Club credit
adjustDialog.description: Add or remove credit from this client's balance. Use a negative amount to deduct.
adjustDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Goodwill credit for rescheduled appointment

cancelDialog.title: Cancel Club membership?
cancelDialog.description: The membership stays active until the end of the current billing period, then stops renewing. Remaining credit is kept until it expires.

toasts.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the adjustment.
toasts.cancelledPeriodEnd: It will end at the close of the current billing period.
